config.thinking_mode: default; no explicit thinking parameter requested
config.cost_basis: Published RUB rates and reported usage; not a Billing statement. Missing cache details are charged at the full input rate.

criteria.normalization: Only a single outer Markdown JSON fence may be removed; record strict_format_ok=false and markdown_wrapper. Do not change answers or code. Apply identically to all models.
criteria.primary_model: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash for H10/H12; YandexGPT remains the primary large model for H5

H5.comparison: YandexGPT vs Qwen3 4B (qwen3:4b); local digest and quantization recorded before local run
H5.interval: 1000 paired bootstrap resamples within A/B, seed 42, 95% percentile CI
H5.decision: confirm if lower>0; reject if upper<=0; otherwise insufficient_data
H5.limitation: Only 8 tasks/type; size is confounded with training and quantization.
H5.deepseek_role: No replacement of the original YandexGPT-vs-Qwen primary comparison. Any DeepSeek-vs-Qwen comparison is secondary and reported separately.

H10.correctness: Numeric tolerance in bank; boolean verdict for B; F07 insufficient_data. Explanations evaluated separately.
H10.statistic: mean(confidence/100)-accuracy on parseable answers with valid confidence; explicitly report coverage, missing confidences and full-denominator accuracy
H10.interval: 1000 bootstrap draws of task groups, seed 42; paired F variants kept together; 95% percentile CI
H10.decision: confirm if lower>0; reject if upper<=0; otherwise insufficient_data
H10.secondary: ECE with bins [0,.2,.4,.6,.8,1], include 1 in last bin; reliability diagram; ECE is not a directional overconfidence test

H12.baseline: LogisticRegression with same six features, same train5/train20 and same test
H12.secondary_metric: balanced_accuracy; GaussianNB and constant-majority baseline also reported
H12.interval: 1000 paired bootstrap test-row resamples, seed 42; one-sided 95% bounds at percentiles 5 and 95
H12.decision: 5-shot: lower delta > -0.05 supports noninferiority, upper delta < -0.05 contradicts it. 20-shot: upper delta < 0 supports loss, lower delta >= 0 contradicts it. Confirm H12 only if both expected parts supported; reject if either contradicted; otherwise insufficient_data. delta=F1_LLM-F1_LR.
H12.baseline_disclosure: Classical baseline and YandexGPT outputs already known. DeepSeek main and E responses not yet obtained.

criteria.multiple_comparisons: Three predeclared exploratory hypotheses; report effect sizes and intervals without claiming familywise-controlled significance. Four-model paired accuracy comparisons additionally use exact McNemar, with Holm correction for that separate family.
criteria.results_not_yet_obtained: No DeepSeek main-bank or E calls before this registration. YandexGPT results already known; H10/H12 are replications using the same rules.

pilot_disclosure.recovery: P01 restored from the raw response after local parser crash on content=null. No additional API call; original latency not available.
pilot_disclosure.parameter_changes_after_pilot: None. Only parser handling of null content in non-message reasoning blocks was corrected; prompts, model and generation parameters were unchanged.

criteria.thinking_limitation: No explicit reasoning parameter, as in YandexGPT. Provider defaults may differ by model; inspect and preserve actual response metadata.

status_note: Configuration and forecasts fixed before DeepSeek main calls; runner records the commit hash in registration_commit.txt.
